text.description_html:
PDQ 6300V605 Polished Brass Heavy Duty Vertical Rod Exit Device

Polished Brass heavy duty surface vertical rod exit device for use on medium and high traffic commercial, hospitality, institutional applications. Suitable for all doors (aluminum, hollow metal, or wood), durable enough for the most demanding applications.

For 30" - 36" Wide Doors, furnished standard with wood and machine screws, optional sex bolts available. Listed for UL 305 Panic and UL 10C Fire Exit Hardware up to 3 hours. ANSI/BHMA Certified Grade 1, A156.3 2001 Exit Devices. Non-handed. reversible for left or right hand doors. Polished Brass finish.

Meets requirements of the Buy American Act. ADA compliant and ICC/ANSI 117.1 for accessible and usable buildings. Compliant with FL #40297 +50/-50 psf 8080 18ga pair.

Specifications for PDQ 6300V605 Vertical Rod Exit Device

  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Rail: Extruded aluminum
  • Top Latch Bolt: Stainless Steel 3/4" Toggle
  • Bottom Latch Bolt: 5/8" Travel Drop Bolt
  • Hand: Device is non-handed
  • Dogging: Hex key dogging standard, cylinder dogging available
  • Application: Surface Vertical Rod (7'0" tall door standard)
  • Stile Width: 3-1/2" minimum
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"-2"
  • Door Width: Standard 3'0" door maximum
  • Door Height: Standard Up to 7' High Door.
  • Certifications: Listed for UL 305 Panic and UL 10C Fire Exit Hardware up to 3 hours. ANSI/BHMA Certified Grade 1, A156.3 2001 Exit Devices. Meets requirements of the Buy American Act. ADA compliant and ICC/ANSI 117.1 for accessible and usable buildings. Compliant with FL #40297 +50/-50 psf 8080 18ga pair.
  • Warranty: Ten (10) year limited manufacture warranty mechanical components
